readings: load has priority and is independent of ena: if load=1, q loads data regardless of ena.
ena gates all register updates: if ena=0, q holds even when load=1; load only applies when ena=1.
q has no specified reset and powers up to an unknown value (e.g., X in simulation, arbitrary in hardware).
q must be initialized to 0 at startup/reset, even though no reset port exists.
All synchronous updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
All synchronous updates occur on the falling edge of clk.
